description: HARD STOP: call this tool ONLY after the user has explicitly approved the screens in a message that arrived AFTER you gave them the dev-server address (first sealing), or when they ask for a data change (later). NEVER in the same turn as writing UI code or asking for their approval: if they have not answered yet, ask and STOP. 'userApproval' must be their exact words. Models / updates the project's data contract (svro.schema.json + svro.workflow.json) from UI component files and business rules, additively. This is the ONLY way to evolve the contract: there is no shell command for it. Pass 'filePaths' (e.g. ['src/components/DeskList.jsx']); 'keyApp' is optional (read from .env). Do NOT read this tool's own JSON definition file from disk (e.g. under ~/.gemini/.../mcp/ozmoz/oz_update_project.json) before calling it — you already have this schema in context via the tool list; re-reading it wastes time and tokens for no new information. Before calling this tool, ask the user (like the framework question) which analysis depth they want for this modeling pass: briefly explain what this step does and what each mode costs, THEN show only the two options as a bare list (recommended option first) — and pass their LITERAL reply as 'modeReply' from your very first call. If you forget and call without it, the tool may fail and tell you to ask; that is a fallback, not the normal path. On success the sync is already done by this tool: do NOT run 'npx ozmoz sync' afterwards. If it returns an error, never run sync to fix a modeling error: call this tool again. Run 'npx ozmoz sync' once only if the error says the sync itself failed.

filePaths.description: Relative paths of ALL files that call oz.* or define data fields.

keyApp.description: Unique application key (e.g. coworking_prod). Optional: if omitted, it is read from OZ_KEY_APP in the project's .env.

modeReply.description: MANDATORY — never omit it, never invent it. Before calling this tool, show the user a numbered [1]/[2] choice for the analysis depth (recommended option first, like you do for the framework question), wait for their reply, then pass their LITERAL reply here (empty/'ok'/'oui' for [1], '2' for [2]).

rules.description: New business rules, calculations, or state transitions.

userApproval.description: The user's EXACT words authorizing this call: their approval of the screens, or their request to change the data. Never write it yourself.

viewFiles.description: View files already loaded in memory [{ name, content }].

name: oz_update_project
